bools.comment: the chiang lung hoard rule - items stolen from the mansion become worthless upon reaching the surface; only items freely given are exempt (print capture p. 261)

bools.comment: the chiang lung daughters - strikingly beautiful and gracious, given in marriage to a courageous or clever hero, a great honor seldom refused; the liaison ends sadly as she returns home never to see her husband again, and the children of such a marriage are spirit folk (print capture p. 261)
